'''Nune soup''', also known as '''locust bean soup''', is a typical Nigerian [[Cookbook:Soup|soup]] that is quick and easy to prepare. It is commonly consumed with ruam kanem ([[Cookbook:Pounded Yam|pounded yam]]) in the Tiv tribe.

==Ingredients==
* Fresh pepper
* [[Cookbook:Fish|Fish]]
* [[Cookbook:Locust Bean|Locust beans]], rinsed
* [[Cookbook:Salt|Salt]]

==Procedure==
# [[Cookbook:Puréeing|Blend]] pepper the pepper to a paste. [[Cookbook:Boiling|Boil]] it for few minutes.
# Add the fish, locust beans, and salt to taste.
# Stir and cook for few minutes.
# Serve with [[Cookbook:Pounded Yam|pounded yam]] or akpu.
